stories.text: As a customer, I want to reset my password by email so that I can get back into my account
acceptance_criteria: The link opens the reset form

stories.text: As a customer, I want to download my order history as CSV so that I can do my taxes
acceptance_criteria: CSV has one row per order

stories.text: As a customer, I want a dark theme so that the site is easier on my eyes

abuse_cases.text: As a customer, I want to guess reset tokens so that I can take over accounts
